name: hotspot-field-for-acf
description: Development tooling for the Hotspot Field for ACF WordPress plugin.

scripts.test:php: npm run test:php:default && npm run test:php:without-acf && npm run test:php:old-acf
scripts.test:php:without-acf: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/hotspot-field-for-acf env HOTSPOT_FIELD_TESTS_WITHOUT_ACF=1 vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite without-acf
scripts.test:php:old-acf: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/hotspot-field-for-acf env HOTSPOT_FIELD_TESTS_ACF_VERSION=5.12.6 vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite old-acf
scripts.test: npm run lint:php && npm run plugin-check && npm run test:php && npm run test:e2e
